title: 🔥 DELIVERANCE OR DECEPTION? What The Chosen Doesn’t Tell You About Mary Magdalene’s Encounter with Jesus!
paragraphs: 🔥 DELIVERANCE OR DECEPTION? What The Chosen Doesn’t Tell You About Mary Magdalene’s Encounter with Jesus!

"Millions of Christians around the world are watching The Chosen and falling in love with a Jesus that feels kind, poetic, and mysterious—but is it the real Jesus of the Bible? Or is this series subtly reprogramming how we view deliverance, doctrine, and truth? In Season 1, Episode 1, The Chosen tells a powerful emotional story about Mary Magdalene being delivered from demons… but what if I told you this version of the story isn’t found anywhere in Scripture?
What if the Jesus on screen is NOT the Jesus of the Gospels?
It’s time to expose the fiction, confront the deception, and return to biblical truth!"

A woman sits alone, tormented by memories, possessed by demons, her identity stolen by darkness.
Religious leaders try to help—but they fail.
She’s told she’s too far gone.
Suddenly, a man shows up, speaks softly, and everything changes.
He doesn’t pray. He doesn’t command.
He whispers:
“I have called you by name… you are mine.”
Powerful, right?
That’s the opening storyline of The Chosen, Season 1, Episode 1—a global hit that has moved millions emotionally, but also quietly shifted theology.

🔥 But what if I told you this scene is not biblical?
🔥 What if I told you Mary Magdalene wasn’t called Lilith, and Jesus never quoted Isaiah 43:1 to her?
🔥 What if The Chosen’s version of Jesus is a soft, cinematic rewrite—not the holy, authoritative, demon-conquering Son of God we see in Scripture?

❓ READER QUESTION FOR BROTHER JOHN:
“Brother John, I watched The Chosen and cried during Mary’s scene… but is it wrong if it’s not exactly how the Bible shows it? Can’t creative liberty be used if it ‘brings people to Jesus’?”
📖 MAIN BIBLE VERSE – Luke 8:2 (KJV):

“And certain women, which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities,
Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven devils…”

🧨 The Bible says Mary was delivered—but it doesn’t say how.
The emotional, poetic drama in The Chosen may make for powerful television, but it also makes for dangerous theology when people accept it as truth.

🚨 THE TRUTH: What This Blog Will Reveal!
✔️ Who Mary Magdalene really was—and how The Chosen altered her story.
✔️ The dangers of mixing biblical characters with fictional narratives and occult names like “Lilith.”
✔️ Why the real Jesus never whispered demons away, and why portraying Him that way is spiritual warfare in disguise.
✔️ How Satan uses emotion to neutralize discernment—and what you must do to escape it.

🔥 This is not about hating a show.
This is about defending the real Jesus, the real Gospel, and the real Word of God.
Are you ready to go deeper?

THE CORE TRUTH REVEALED – WHAT DOES THE BIBLE SAY?
❓ READER QUESTION:
“Brother John, how did Mary Magdalene actually meet Jesus? Did He really call her 'Lilith'? Did He quote Isaiah 43 to deliver her?”

📖 THE BIBLICAL RECORD – CLEAN, CLEAR, AUTHORITATIVE TRUTH:
Luke 8:1–2 (KJV):

“And it came to pass afterward, that he went throughout every city and village, preaching and shewing the glad tidings of the kingdom of God: and the twelve were with him,
And certain women, which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities,
Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven devils…”
Mark 16:9 (KJV):

“Now when Jesus was risen early the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene,
out of whom he had cast seven devils.”

🔥 WHAT THIS REVEALS:
✔ Mary was demon-possessed—not just emotionally damaged.
✔ Jesus delivered her completely.
✔ NO DETAILS are given about how He did it.
✔ The Bible never says she was in a tavern… or named Lilith… or was suicidal.
🚨 That’s ALL extra-biblical Hollywood storytelling.

💣 EXPOSING THE CHOSEN’S VERSION:
In The Chosen, Episode 1:
Mary is referred to as Lilith—a demonic name from Jewish mysticism.
She is suicidal and self-harming.
She’s delivered after Jesus whispers:
“I have called you by name… You are mine.” (Isaiah 43:1)
Sounds deep, right?
BUT…

📖 THE BIBLE NEVER SHOWS JESUS QUOTING ISAIAH TO CAST OUT DEMONS.
Isaiah 43:1 (KJV):

“But now thus saith the Lord that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel,
Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.”

💣 CONTEXT: This verse was spoken to Israel as a nation—not to Mary as an individual.
Using it in a mystical whisper to cast out demons is a blatant misuse of Scripture.

📖 JESUS’ REAL METHOD OF DELIVERANCE:
Matthew 8:16 (KJV):
“...he cast out the spirits with his word, and healed all that were sick.”
Mark 1:27 (KJV):
“...with authority commandeth he even the unclean spirits, and they do obey him.”

🔥 Jesus didn’t comfort demons.
🔥 He didn’t whisper poetry.
🔥 He commanded them with divine authority.

🧠 GREEK WORD STUDY – "Cast Out"
Greek Word: ekballō (ἐκβάλλω)
Definition: To forcibly eject, expel, or drive out with violence.
👉 This isn’t gentle. This isn’t poetic. This is power confrontation with hell.

🛡 THE DANGEROUS IMPLICATION:
Portraying Jesus as quiet, poetic, and non-confrontational during demonic deliverance redefines who He is.
And redefining Jesus = preaching another Jesus.
2 Corinthians 11:4 (KJV):
“For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached… ye might well bear with him.”
🚨 The Chosen gives us a fictionalized Jesus, mixing Bible, emotion, and mysticism.

💣 LILITH = OCCULT CONNECTION
FACT:
“Lilith” is a name found in Babylonian demonology and Jewish mysticism, later used in feminist witchcraft to represent rebellion against God and man.
⚠ To rename Mary as “Lilith” is not only inaccurate, it’s spiritually dangerous.

💭 READER QUESTION:
“Brother John, if people are being inspired by The Chosen, is it really that bad?”

🔥 TRUTH:
Yes—because inspiration without truth is how Satan deceives millions.
It doesn’t matter how it makes you feel. What matters is if it’s biblically accurate.

BIBLICAL & HISTORICAL PROOF – CONFIRMING THE TRUTH!
📖 BIBLICAL PROOF – JESUS DELIVERS WITH AUTHORITY, NOT ARTISTIC WHISPERING
Matthew 8:16 (KJV):
“...he cast out the spirits with his word, and healed all that were sick.”
Mark 1:34 (KJV):
“And he healed many that were sick of divers diseases, and cast out many devils; and suffered not the devils to speak, because they knew him.”
Luke 4:35–36 (KJV):

“And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him. And when the devil had thrown him in the midst, he came out of him, and hurt him not.
And they were all amazed, and spake among themselves, saying, What a word is this! For with authority and power he commandeth the unclean spirits, and they come out.”

🔥 REVELATION:
✔ Jesus didn't have to "connect emotionally" with the possessed.
✔ He didn’t use Scripture as a poetic tool—He used it as a sword.
✔ He didn’t quote Isaiah to cast out demons—He spoke in power, and the demonic realm obeyed immediately.
📖 Hebrews 4:12 (KJV):
“For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword…”
📖 Luke 10:19 (KJV):
“Behold, I give unto you power… over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.”

🧠 THE DANGER OF ADDING TO SCRIPTURE
📖 Proverbs 30:6 (KJV):
“Add thou not unto his words, lest he reprove thee, and thou be found a liar.”
📖 Revelation 22:18 (KJV):
“If any man shall add unto these things, God shall add unto him the plagues…”
🚨 The Chosen adds scenes, dialogue, and a theological method of deliverance that is not in Scripture. That is adding to the Word.

🏺 HISTORICAL RECORDS – EARLY CHURCH WITNESSES AGREE
📜 Irenaeus – Against Heresies (c. 180 AD)
✅ He confirms that Mary Magdalene was a disciple and a witness of the resurrection.
🚫 He never calls her “Lilith,” nor does he mention any poetic deliverance.
🔗 https://www.ccel.org/ccel/schaff/anf01.ix.iv.xxii.html

📜 Eusebius – Ecclesiastical History (c. 325 AD)
✅ Recorded Mary Magdalene as among the earliest and most faithful disciples.
🚫 No mention of mysticism or fabricated scenes.
✅ Confirms her central role in early Christian testimony.
🔗 https://www.newadvent.org/fathers/250101.htm

💣 THE OCCULT ORIGIN OF “LILITH” – SPIRITUAL INFILTRATION
The name Lilith appears in:
Babylonian demonology
Kabbalah mysticism
Feminist rebellion mythology
Meaning: "night demon," "storm spirit," "child-killer" in ancient lore.
🔥 WHY THIS MATTERS: To assign Mary Magdalene the name “Lilith” connects her to occult powers—not deliverance, not Scripture, not truth.
🚨 It is a spiritual Trojan horse—normalizing false doctrine through fictional empathy.

⚠ READER WARNING:
If you accept fiction as doctrine, you will eventually accept a false Christ (Matthew 24:24).
📖 Galatians 1:8 (KJV):
“But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel… let him be accursed.”

💭 READER QUESTION:
“Brother John, what if God still uses The Chosen to bring people to Jesus?”

🔥 RESPONSE:
God can use a crooked stick to draw a straight line—but that doesn’t mean the stick is safe.
We don’t test something by results—we test it by the Word.
📖 1 Thessalonians 5:21 (KJV):
“Prove all things; hold fast that which is good.”

OLD TESTAMENT PROPHECY CONNECTIONS
🎯 The Chosen misapplies Isaiah 43:1—but the real Messiah fulfilled prophecy with fire, not fiction.

📖 PROPHECY #1 – JESUS CAME TO CAST OUT DEMONS WITH POWER
Isaiah 61:1 (KJV):

🔥 JESUS FULFILLED THIS PROPHECY IN LUKE 4:18–21, and when He did—
✔ He read it publicly.
✔ He declared: “This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears.”
✔ He didn’t whisper it over a possessed person. He proclaimed it in the synagogue with boldness.

📖 PROPHECY #2 – JESUS WOULD BREAK DEMONIC OPPRESSION, NOT CRAFT SCENES
Zechariah 13:2 (KJV):
“...I will cause the prophets and the unclean spirit to pass out of the land.”

✔ Jesus came to cleanse the land, not romanticize evil.
✔ He fulfilled the demon-destroying prophecies by casting them out with a word—not by mysterious interactions.

📖 PROPHECY #3 – GOD CALLS HIS PEOPLE BY NAME… BUT NOT AS A DELIVERANCE TECHNIQUE
Isaiah 43:1 (KJV):
“Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.”

🚨 This prophecy is directed to ISRAEL, not Mary Magdalene.
✔ It speaks to God's covenant with His chosen nation—not as a spiritual exorcism spell.
✔ To take a covenantal verse for Israel and repackage it as a demonic deliverance method is theological error.

💣 WHY THIS IS DANGEROUS:
Using Old Testament prophecy as cinematic dialogue reduces the holiness of God's Word to mere screenwriting material.
📖 Jeremiah 23:36 (KJV):
“...for ye have perverted the words of the living God, of the LORD of hosts our God.”
🚨 The Chosen doesn’t honor prophecy—it repurposes it for emotional effect.

💭 READER QUESTION:
“Brother John, if a verse sounds good in a show, is it really wrong to use it like that?”

🔥 TRUTH:
Yes. Because God's Word is not a script—it's sacred. It must be interpreted and applied in context, or else it becomes a tool of deception.

REAL-LIFE TESTIMONY – “Jomar’s Deliverance Wasn’t From a Whisper… But From the Word!”
❓ READER QUESTION:
“Brother John, do you personally know anyone who was delivered from demons like Mary Magdalene?”

🔥 YES, I DO.
I have a close friend—his name is Jomar.
He wasn’t possessed by Hollywood fiction. He was tormented by real darkness.
He told me his story:

“Brother John, I was deep in darkness. I didn’t know how to explain it. I had suicidal thoughts every week. I couldn’t sleep. I would feel invisible hands choking me at night. I would curse, lash out, and feel completely empty after. My family was scared of me.
I went to religious counselors. One gave me rosaries. Another gave me holy water. But the demons didn’t budge.

Then someone invited me to a real Bible-preaching church. I heard the Gospel. They prayed over me. And when they spoke the name of Jesus Christ with authority, something inside me screamed and came out.
I fell on the floor and shook. I couldn’t control my body. And then… PEACE.
Not emotional peace. Not cinematic peace. REAL deliverance. The kind where chains are broken and the Word of God fills your soul.”

Now Jomar is one of the boldest young evangelists I know.
He’s full of fire, full of Scripture, and completely changed.

📖 CONFIRMING SCRIPTURE:
John 8:36 (KJV):
“If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.”
Matthew 12:28 (KJV):
“But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God is come unto you.”

💣 REVELATION:
✔️ Jomar wasn’t delivered by emotion.
✔️ He wasn’t freed by holy water, saints, or whispering verses.
✔️ He was set free by the real Jesus—through the real power of His Word.

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, if Jesus is the same yesterday, today, and forever (Hebrews 13:8), shouldn’t His method of deliverance still be the same too?"
🔥 EXACTLY. And that’s why we must reject fictional, dramatized portrayals that soften or distort His authority.

FINAL CHALLENGE – WILL YOU CHOOSE GOD’S TRUTH OR MAN’S VERSION?
❓ READER QUESTION:
“Brother John, does it really matter if the scene isn’t in the Bible—as long as it inspires people?”

💣 ANSWER: YES—IT MATTERS FOR ETERNITY!
📖 2 Timothy 4:3–4 (KJV):
“For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears;
And they shall turn away their ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables.”
🔥 The Chosen becomes a fable when it rewrites biblical encounters with fantasy.

BIBLICAL TRUTH VS. SCREEN FICTION:
The real Jesus cast out demons with a word—not poetic whispers.
The real Jesus never called Mary “Lilith”—that name comes from Babylonian demonology.
The real Jesus fulfilled prophecy properly—He didn’t misuse verses like Isaiah 43:1 for drama.
The real Jesus spoke with raw, holy authority—not scripted sentiment.
The real Gospel doesn’t need Hollywood—it stands in power alone.

🚨 YOU HAVE A CHOICE TO MAKE:
✔ Will you follow the Jesus of the Bible—who commands demons, confronts sin, and declares truth?
❌ Or will you follow a fictional version—designed to move emotions but not save souls?

📖 Galatians 1:8 (KJV):
“But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed.”

🔥 Emotional inspiration can’t save you.
🔥 Only truth can.

THE FOOL’S RESPONSE VS. THE WISE RESPONSE
📖 Proverbs 14:15 (KJV):
“The simple believeth every word: but the prudent man looketh well to his going.”

❌ THE FOOL’S RESPONSE:
“It’s just a show—don’t be so serious.”
“But it helped me feel closer to God…”
“They probably meant well, so it’s not that bad.”
“You’re just being overly religious and critical.”
“I don’t care if it’s accurate… it’s beautiful.”

🚨 Foolish thinking is emotion-driven, not Word-driven.
The fool loves comfort, not correction.

✅ THE WISE RESPONSE:
“If it’s not in the Bible, I won’t build my belief on it.”
“I test every spirit—including popular Christian media.”
“The Word of God is my final authority, not a TV series.”
“I will not tolerate any version of Jesus that isn’t biblical.”
“I’d rather be biblically accurate than emotionally moved.”
🔥 The wise man values truth over tears, doctrine over drama, and Scripture over sentiment.

📖 Matthew 7:24 (KJV):
“Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock.”

📖 Matthew 7:26 (KJV):
“And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand.”

💣 Final thought:
The wise don’t just watch. They weigh.
They don’t just feel. They filter everything through the Word.

WHAT IF YOU DIED TONIGHT?
❓ READER QUESTION:
“Brother John… if I’ve been moved by The Chosen but not truly changed, what should I do?”

📖 Hebrews 9:27 (KJV):
“And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment.”

💣 The Chosen ends with background music and emotion.
But your life ends with judgment before a holy God.

⚠ REALITY CHECK:
If you died tonight…
If your heart stopped in your sleep…
If you stood before the throne of God…

Would you say:
✔ “I repented. I believed the Gospel. I followed the Word.”
❌ Or would you say: “But I loved that show… it made me feel close to Jesus…”?

📖 Matthew 7:21–23 (KJV):
“Not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven…
Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord…
And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity.”
🔥 YOUR SALVATION MUST BE BUILT ON SCRIPTURE—NOT SENTIMENT.

📖 Romans 10:17 (KJV):
“So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.”

📖 Romans 10:9 (KJV):
“That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.”

⚔ GOSPEL CHALLENGE:
If you have not fully surrendered to Jesus Christ based on the Word of God, not a show…
📢 Now is the time.
Repent. Believe the Gospel. Follow Jesus—not the version the world gives you, but the one found in Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John.

SATAN’S SNEAK ATTACKS – HOW THE ENEMY OPERATES THROUGH ENTERTAINMENT
📖 2 Corinthians 11:14 (KJV):
“And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.”

❓ READER QUESTION:
“Brother John, are you saying Satan can use something like The Chosen—even if it’s ‘Christian’?”

🔥 YES—AND THAT’S EXACTLY WHAT MAKES IT DANGEROUS.
Satan doesn’t always appear with horns and fire.
He often comes as a smiling Jesus, soft music, a tear-jerking scene, and just enough Bible to disarm your discernment.

💣 SATAN’S STRATEGY #1 – MIXTURE:
He blends truth with fiction.
He makes you say, “That’s powerful,” instead of asking, “Is that biblical?”
📖 Galatians 5:9 (KJV):
“A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.”

❌ One verse misused.
❌ One name like “Lilith” inserted.
❌ One fictional scene accepted as truth.
✅ That’s all it takes for the enemy to plant seeds of confusion.

💣 SATAN’S STRATEGY #2 – DESENSITIZATION:
He gets believers so comfortable with fiction…
…they stop recognizing false doctrine when it’s preached from the pulpit.

If Satan can get Christians emotionally moved by a false Jesus,
he’s already trained them to accept the Antichrist without resistance.
📖 Matthew 24:24 (KJV):
“For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall shew great signs and wonders… insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.”

💣 SATAN’S STRATEGY #3 – ENTERTAINMENT OVER EDIFICATION:
Satan wants to dull your sword by keeping you entertained but untrained.

💬 Christians will binge-watch The Chosen…
…But won’t read Matthew 8, Mark 5, or Luke 4—the real deliverance chapters.
📖 Hosea 4:6 (KJV):
“My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge…”

💣 SATAN’S STRATEGY #4 – REDESIGN JESUS INTO A SAFE VERSION:
Satan hates the Jesus who: ✔ Casts out devils
✔ Exposes sin
✔ Preaches hell
✔ Demands repentance
So he presents a soft, poetic, inclusive, and therapeutic version of Jesus.
🚨 That’s not Jesus. That’s a false Christ.

💥 REVELATION:
Satan’s greatest weapon isn’t violence.
It’s deception wrapped in beauty, charm, emotion, and “spiritual” language.

GOSPEL WARRIOR DECLARATION – YOUR PUBLIC STAND FOR TRUTH
❓ READER QUESTION:
“Brother John, what should I do now that I know The Chosen has deception in it?”

🔥 You don’t just walk away informed—you rise up transformed.
If you’re done tolerating soft Christianity...
If you’re done letting entertainment blur your convictions...
If you want to stand for the real Jesus...
Then say this declaration out loud—and mean it.

🛡️ GOSPEL WARRIOR DECLARATION – REPEAT OUT LOUD:
“Lord Jesus Christ, I reject every false version of You.
I will no longer be deceived by emotional storytelling or unscriptural portrayals.
I choose truth over tradition, Scripture over sentiment, and conviction over comfort.
You are my Savior, my Deliverer, and my King—not a poetic character on a screen.
I stand on Your Word alone.
I renounce false doctrine and emotional compromise.
I declare: I AM A GOSPEL WARRIOR.
In Jesus’ mighty name, AMEN!”
